quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #2
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mean no passing zone.

questions.question: Is it legal to drive while holding a pet on your lap?

options.text: Yes, if the animal is asleep.
Yes, but it is not recommended.

questions.explanation: Holding an animal while driving is illegal and dangerous. It is a form of distracted driving. You may get additional penalties for distracted driving along with other traffic violations.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition, road condition, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with multiple curves ahead.

questions.question: How can you reduce hydroplaning risk?

options.text: Do not speed on wet roads.
Keep tires at proper air pressure.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when tires glide on water between the tire and road. Low air pressure, worn tread, and speeding all increase hydroplaning risk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What should a driver do if they see an animal on the road?

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.explanation: Always be very cautious when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly so you do not scare it.

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to sudden problems.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to sudden problems.
questions.explanation: Leave plenty of space between you and other vehicles so you have time to react if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: When is street racing acceptable?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal and causes serious injuries or deaths. Illegal racers put all drivers at risk by racing on public roads at high speeds. High speeds prevent drivers from reacting to road hazards and other traffic situations, which causes crashes.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid hydroplaning?

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch for standing water or puddles.

questions.explanation: On wet roads, cars need more distance to stop and may skid during quick turns. Do not use cruise control on wet or icy roads. Reduce your speed and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What is the only way to lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Let your body break down the alcohol over time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let your body break down the alcohol over time.
questions.explanation: The only way to reduce your BAC is to wait for your body to process the alcohol. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot lower your BAC or make you sober. They may help keep you awake, but they do not reduce alcohol in your system.

questions.question: Which of these commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Driving too close to other vehicles

questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of crashes. Not paying attention can cause you to hit other vehicles. Most rear-end collisions happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: What should drivers do when they see a flashing red light?

options.text: Drive through if no other cars are crossing.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights mark dangerous intersections. Always treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: To prepare for road hazards ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the entire road and sides of the road constantly.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Rest your left foot lightly on the brake pedal while driving.
Keep your eyes focused on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the entire road and sides of the road constantly.
questions.explanation: You can handle dangerous situations better by spotting problems early. Look far ahead, but do not just stare at the center of the road. You must constantly check the whole road and the sides of the road.

questions.question: You may carefully continue through an intersection when the light turns yellow if:

options.text: An emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the light turns yellow while you are already in the intersection, you may continue carefully through it.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: When you see railroad tracks ahead, you should:

options.text: Look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Drive around a lowered crossing gate.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains or other vehicles. Slow down and be ready to stop at railroad tracks.

questions.question: What will help someone recover from drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows alcohol to leave your body.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, you should:
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians. Sound it if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white with black markings. Drivers must obey them. This sign prohibits passing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that people may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Get ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: You are in an accident. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle right away. Move it out of traffic if you can. Call the police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Help stop any bleeding. Wait for emergency help to arrive.

questions.question: Two solid white lines mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Cars have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks.
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show where pedestrians can safely cross. You must always stop for people using the crosswalk.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers don't see other vehicles or make unexpected moves. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the center means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: On long trips, how can you prevent drowsiness?

options.text: Move your eyes side to side as you drive.

questions.explanation: Take regular breaks on long trips. Rest and stretch, even if you don't feel tired.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.
